verdict.rationale: Gusto documents date-based API versioning: a dedicated API-versioning page sets the version via the X-Gusto-API-Version header, Postman collections are published per version, and behavior changes are tied to named versions such as 2023-02-01. Nothing in the evidence describes a deprecation policy, such as support windows, sunset timelines or deprecation notices. The object-level 'version' field (gusto-docs-25) is optimistic concurrency control, not API versioning, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy, version support lifecycle details, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Set your API version using the `X-Gusto-API-Version` header
We publish separate collections for each API version.
Starting from version `2023-02-01`, error messages will have consistent JSON structures.
